name: Apple strudel
author: Lorenzo Iuri on based.cooking
steps: Peel and cut the apples in thin slices.
Roll out the puff pastry with a rolling pin.
Spread the jam over the puff pastry with a spoon.
Arrange the apple slices over the jam.
Cut tiny pieces of butter and arrange them over the apple slices.
Roll the puff pastry edges over, overlapping them.

culture.text: Apple strudel is a traditional Viennese strudel, a popular pastry in Austria, Switzerland, Bavaria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Northern Italy, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia-Herzegovina and other countries in Europe that once belonged to the Austro-Hungarian Empire (1867–1918).
